yield.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, in US trials, the self-ordering screens that McDonald's is currently installing at its 1,300 UK restaurants yielded a reported 30% rise in order values.
yield.translationZh: 与此同时，在美国的试点中，麦当劳目前在英国 1,300 家餐厅安装的自助点餐机据报道使订单额增长了 30%。

yield.sentenceEn: Flashing Yellow lights mean yield or signal caution, like outside of a fire station.
yield.translationZh: 黄灯闪烁表示礼让或警示，例如在消防局门外。

yield.sentenceEn: If you have a flashing yellow light, you are to yield to oncoming traffic.
yield.translationZh: 如果你遇到闪烁的黄灯，必须避让迎面而来的车辆。

yield.sentenceEn: According to a professor, when the yields of staple crops fall, we will have to adapt to eating foods from alternative crops.
yield.translationZh: 一位教授表示，当主粮作物产量下降时，我们将不得不适应食用替代作物的食物。
它们产生了一些出人意料的发现。

youth.sentenceEn: Some of the specific ways in which libraries add value to our communities and serve as cultural centers for our patrons are community builders, centers for the arts, and champions of youth .
youth.translationZh: 图书馆为社区创造价值并作为读者文化中心的具体方式包括：社区建设者、艺术中心和青少年倡导者。

youth.sentenceEn: In addition, library book groups allow people to explore and discuss the literary arts, and the Great Stories Club introduces at-risk youth to literature.
youth.translationZh: 此外，图书馆读书会让人们能够探索和讨论文学艺术，而“伟大故事俱乐部”则向高危青少年介绍文学作品。

youth.sentenceEn: This is the age women start to become "invisible"—our value, attractiveness and power supposedly diminished by the vanishing of youth .
youth.translationZh: 人们常说，到了这个年纪，女性开始变得“隐形”——我们的价值、魅力和影响力，似乎都随着青春的消逝而减退。
youth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

youth.sentenceEn: I wouldn't go back to the crippling self-consciousness of my youth if you paid me.
youth.translationZh: 就算有人付钱，我也不会回到年轻时那种令人窒息的自我意识中去。
youth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

youth.sentenceEn: It deterred luxury consumers who found their expensive clothing more closely associated with working-class youth culture than a prestigious heritage fashion house.
youth.translationZh: 这让奢侈品消费者望而却步，他们发现自己高价购买的服装，与其说是出自久负盛名的传统时尚品牌，不如说更像是与工薪阶层青年文化相关联的产物。

youth.sentenceEn: It can be concluded from experiments that the presence of peers increases risk-taking by adolescents and youth .
youth.translationZh: 实验可得出结论：同伴的在场会增加青少年和青年的冒险行为。

yeah.sentenceEn: W: Yeah , I spoke to a lady there last Tuesday, which is now 10 days ago.
yeah.translationZh: 女：是的，我上周二和那里的一位女士谈过，也就是10天前了。
yeah.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句
文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

yeah.sentenceEn: M: Yeah , it really is, both for students and teachers.
yeah.translationZh: 男：是啊，确实如此，对学生和老师来说都是这样。
yeah.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

yeah.sentenceEn: W: Yeah , but if you are struggling to work with young people in your workspace, what can you do?
yeah.translationZh: 女：没错，但如果你在职场中很难与年轻人共事，该怎么办呢？
yeah.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

yeah.sentenceEn: W: Yeah , it's a little simplistic perhaps.
yeah.translationZh: 是啊，这可能有点过于简单了。
yeah.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

youngster.sentenceEn: The youngsters fall into three groups: those who take after-school music, those who do after-school sports, and those with no structured after-school program at all.
youngster.translationZh: 这些青少年被分为三组：一组参加课外音乐活动，一组参加课外体育活动，还有一组完全不参加有组织的课外活动。

youngster.sentenceEn: It could be that the youngsters who play the piano also happen to be more ambitious or better at focusing on a task.
youngster.translationZh: 这可能是因为学钢琴的孩子恰好更有抱负，或者更善于专注于一项任务。

youngster.sentenceEn: My own research at the Stanford Center on Adolescence uses in-depth interviews with small samples of youngsters rather than large-scale surveys.
youngster.translationZh: 我个人在斯坦福青少年研究中心的研究采用的是对小样本青少年进行深度访谈，而非大规模调查。

youngster.sentenceEn: We, of course, need to pay attention to youngsters who are filled with discontent and hostility, but we should not allow these extreme cases to distort our view of most young people.
youngster.translationZh: 当然，我们需要关注那些内心充满不满与敌意的青少年，但不应让这些极端案例扭曲我们对大多数年轻人的看法。

youngster.sentenceEn: Parents, teachers, even the kids themselves, scored the youngsters on measures like "acting before thinking" and "persistence in reaching goals".
youngster.translationZh: 家长、老师甚至孩子们自己都根据一些行为表现对这些孩子进行了评分，比如“行动前不加思考”和“达成目标的毅力”。
youngster.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

youngster.sentenceEn: Many hitherto unobserved youngsters may have psychological problems.
youngster.translationZh: 许多此前未被察觉的青少年可能存在心理问题。
